faq_q1: What are the university registration requirements?
faq_a1: You must hold a baccalaureate diploma and have a grade point average suitable for the specific college.
faq_a2: Yes, there is transportation to and from the university.
faq_a3: Yes, the university is officially licensed by a legislative decree from the Syrian Arab Republic, and all its degrees are fully recognized by the Syrian Ministry of Higher Education; they qualify graduates to register with professional syndicates and pursue postgraduate studies both within and outside Syria.
faq_q4: Does the university accept non-Syrian or older secondary school certificates?
faq_a4: Yes, the university accepts non-Syrian certificates (whether Arab or foreign), provided they are attested and their equivalence is certified by the Ministry of Education and the Syrian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
faq_q5: Does the university offer scholarships or discounts?
faq_a5: Yes, an annual free ministerial scholarship is offered to high-achieving students, in addition to special discounts for siblings and for students who excel academically on a semester basis.
dean_pharmacy_title: Dr. Bashar Al-Azzam Dean of the Faculty of Pharmacy at Al-Jazira Private University
dean_pharmacy_message: Dear visitors and esteemed students of the Faculty of Pharmacy at Al-Jazira Private University, We extend a warm welcome to you to the Faculty of Pharmacy’s website. We wish to assure you that we are constantly striving to do our utmost to support you and to create opportunities for your success and advancement. Fully recognizing the significant responsibility the Faculty of Pharmacy bears in preparing highly competent and experienced pharmacists—and in enabling them to play an active role in society—I consider it a great honor to shoulder this noble responsibility as Dean of the Faculty of Pharmacy at our beloved university. The College strives to realize its vision, mission, and objectives—derived from those of the University—which are subject to continuous updating and periodic evaluation in line with the requirements of each stage. In doing so, it adopts a philosophy grounded in a set of core values, foremost among them the advancement of knowledge, the cultivation of ethics and academic integrity, a commitment to development and modernization, teamwork, and the encouragement of scientific research, self-learning, and lifelong learning—all aimed at fostering an academic environment that nurtures creativity and innovation. The Faculty of Pharmacy strives to provide the necessary support for the continuous improvement of educational performance quality, aiming to achieve excellence in student preparation and scientific research, and to secure local and international program accreditation. In conclusion, I would like to extend my gratitude to the university administration—represented by the University President—as well as to the faculty members of the Faculty of Pharmacy and the committee formed from among them to develop this strategic plan.
dean_it_message: As it marks the end of its fifth year, the College of Information Technology at Al-Jazira Private University has grown into a flourishing tree, surrounded by students of science and guided by distinguished professors and educators. We live in a rapidly evolving and fast-growing world that has achieved technological advancements beyond imagination, transforming the globe into a closely connected village. This remarkable progress is the product of the human mind, which God has endowed with extraordinary abilities surpassing even the most sophisticated technologies. The true wealth of nations lies in their distinguished individuals who use their intellect to harness the forces of nature and utilize the resources bestowed upon the earth to build a better future and advance society in all aspects of life. The College is committed to its students because it believes they represent this true national wealth. It strives to cultivate knowledgeable and innovative minds capable of contributing to development and progress across all fields. Faculty members, lecturers, teaching assistants, technicians, and administrative staff work together to support and guide this promising generation, equipping them with the knowledge and skills necessary to become productive members of society. It gives me great pleasure to congratulate our students on joining this prestigious academic institution, and I encourage them to make knowledge, learning, integrity, and dedication a lifelong path in serving their communities and their nation.
dean_architecture_message: Dear students, I would like to welcome you to the college you have chosen as your future academic and professional path. I also welcome you to the field of architecture, which will become the foundation of your future career. I am pleased to work alongside my colleagues to help you develop into architects who possess both the theoretical knowledge and creative imagination necessary to excel in this profession. The College strives to provide an environment that encourages scientific thinking and creative work within advanced academic frameworks, enabling you to transform innovative ideas into distinctive architectural achievements and practical solutions that meet the needs of society and sustainable development. The University also seeks to strengthen cooperation and exchange programs with many partner universities, allowing you to engage with diverse architectural cultures and experiences. I wish you every success in your academic journey and assure you that my colleagues and I, together with the academic and administrative staff, will always support you and help you overcome any challenges you may encounter.
dean_business_title: Dean of the College of Business Administration, Dr. Abdul Rahman Marai
dean_business_message: Business Administration is one of the most important disciplines, aiming to achieve qualitative development in economic, educational, and industrial institutions. Therefore, the College of Business Administration plays a vital role in preparing a generation of students who are fully aware of the responsibilities and challenges they will face in their future careers. The College seeks to develop creative graduates with strong intellectual and professional awareness by providing opportunities to acquire scientific and practical knowledge and skills through the latest developments in management sciences, both theoretical and applied. It also focuses on preparing students academically and professionally to compete successfully in the labor market or pursue postgraduate studies alongside graduates from other universities. In addition, the College is committed to developing students’ research and innovation capabilities through participation in research seminars, training programs in economic and social institutions, and the preparation of graduation projects that meet recognized standards of scientific research in both theoretical and practical aspects.
dean_civil_title: Head of Civil Engineering Department Dr. Fawaz Masouti
dean_civil_message: My dear students in the Civil Engineering Department, I commend you on your choice of the esteemed profession of engineering, and I wish you a fruitful and successful academic journey at the Faculty of Civil Engineering, filled with achievement and memorable experiences. Civil engineering is the oldest and broadest of the engineering disciplines, playing a vital role in urban, social, cultural, scientific, and economic development throughout the world. The impact of civil engineers is evident in all development plans and engineering projects that contribute to building and advancing societies. In response to the rapid developments taking place around the globe, the Civil Engineering Department at Al Jazeera Private University offers a distinguished academic program designed to prepare qualified civil engineers capable of undertaking diverse engineering responsibilities and contributing to the planning and implementation of society’s development needs. The curriculum covers a wide range of civil engineering fields, including structural engineering, transportation and highway engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental and sanitary engineering, hydraulic structures, and engineering management. Teaching and research are carried out by highly qualified academics and researchers with extensive scientific and practical expertise, whose mission is to equip students with the skills needed to research, apply knowledge effectively, think critically, and pursue lifelong learning throughout their professional careers. Finally, I wish you a bright future in which you contribute to the advancement of your nation. You are the heirs of great civilizations that combined knowledge and values, illuminated the path of humanity, and continue to contribute to the progress of society and the world.

medical_service_description: The University provides students with a medical clinic under the supervision of a full-time doctor, equipped with ambulances when necessary. The University also provides comprehensive health insurance for all new students through the service fees paid during enrollment.
university_activities_description: The University is keen to strengthen its connection with the community through targeted social activities held each semester. It also organizes seminars and cultural and scientific competitions to enhance students' academic and cultural excellence. The university administration promotes sports activities by enabling students to participate in various competitions held among Syrian universities. In the past academic year, the University organized many events across different fields, with frequent and remarkable weekly activities. These include national, cultural, and social events.
student_accommodation_description: The University contributes to providing accommodation for students who wish to benefit from this service at an affordable price and under the supervision of the university.
electronic_services_description: The University offers a variety of electronic services that enable students to access information and complete important academic and administrative procedures during their studies electronically. These include the Student Portal, which provides access to all academic and financial information, as well as viewing test results and final exam results online. The University also provides an electronic registration service, allowing students to register their courses at the beginning of each semester from any place without needing to come to the university, in addition to an electronic payment service offered to students.
exam_instructions_intro: All students must strictly follow the instructions below during exams. Any violation may result in academic consequences.
exam_rule_1: Students are not allowed to enter the exam room after the distribution of papers.
exam_rule_2: Students must bring their university ID or personal identification.
exam_rule_3: Mobile phones or any electronic devices are strictly prohibited inside the exam room.
exam_rule_4: Students must maintain silence and avoid communication with others during the exam.
exam_rule_5: Bringing any unauthorized books, papers, or reference materials is not allowed.
exam_rule_6: Cheating or attempting to cheat will result in strict disciplinary actions.
exam_rule_7: Students must submit their answer sheets before leaving the exam room; removing them is prohibited.
exam_rule_8: Invigilators have the right to remove any student causing disturbance or breaking the rules.
exam_rule_9: Ensure that the full name and university ID are correctly written on the answer sheet.

about_us_description: Al-Jazira Private University is committed to achieving educational and academic excellence, fostering a culture of distinction across its curricula, faculty, and student body. We constantly strive to develop competencies and provide an interactive learning environment that meets the aspirations of the younger generation. Through partnerships and twinning arrangements with peer universities, we continuously update our academic programs to align with global standards and actual labor market demands, while placing a strong emphasis on the quality of our graduates and on scientific research.
